visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair, wearing a black and white baseball cap and a brown plaid shirt over a black t-shirt, holds up a stack of blue and white lottery tickets close to the camera while smiling. (2) The man stands in a brightly lit shopping mall corridor, gesturing towards a yellow and blue circular sign that reads 'TOY e GO' above glass doors. (3) The camera pans across a detailed poster advertising a 'Godzilla' themed lottery, showing various monster figurines labeled A through G with Japanese text. (4) Inside the store, the man interacts at a red counter with a staff member wearing a mask; a box full of lottery tickets sits on the counter as the man prepares to open his haul. (5) A montage follows where the man's hands peel open numerous small blue and white tickets one by one, revealing prize letters like 'G', 'H', 'F', and 'E', while text overlays track the results. (6) The man displays large cardboard art boards (G prize) featuring cinematic Godzilla imagery and small collectible cards in plastic sleeves (F prize). (7) He points at his black t-shirt which features a grid of historical Godzilla movie posters from various years. (8) The man opens small black blind boxes (H and E prizes), revealing thick rubber magnets and a small 3D Godzilla head sculpt, which he holds up to his face for a close-up while giving a thumbs-up. (9) He concludes by pointing at a large boxed prize (A prize) on the counter that remains unopened as he gestures towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and positive valence, accompanied by a bright, medium-tempo pop synthesizer track. (2) There is a soft mechanical click and the sound of paper rustling as a box is handled. (3) The primary speaker's pitch rises excitedly while describing figurines, layered over subtle background mall ambiance. (4) Distinct percussive 'tearing' and 'rustling' sounds occur as multiple paper lottery tickets are peeled open in rapid succession. (5) Each new prize reveal is punctuated by a short digital pop or whoosh sound effect in the post-production mix. (6) A metallic 'clink' is heard as a magnet is applied to a hollow metal surface, followed by the speaker laughing briefly. (7) The speaker's tone shifts to a slightly lower pitch, expressing moderate disappointment while still maintaining a friendly and engaged conversational style.
